tenures.note: No date survives for this tenure: the first-owner era predates the one held UWA document, which names him only in passing.

notes: Named as the UWA's first owner in NFW's own retrospective About page (promotions/nfw/archive/about-new-frontier-wrestling-season-2-site.html), which records that in roleplay "the UWA closed due to financial struggles that were induced by Anne Mystic's kidnapping attempt on UWA's first owner, Avery Everette." The Random Rumble card names him once, in commentary. NFW later named a kayfabe trophy of its own the Avery Everette Memorial Cup.
caption: The UWA's first owner in its own fiction, whose kidnapping at the hands of Anne Mystic is the reason the promotion's own record gives for its financial collapse, and who is remembered on Random Rumble night only as "that walking skeleton Everette."
